name: smwmusic-thunder-force-iv-space-walk
title: Thunder Force IV - Space Walk
description:
This is Space Walk from Thunder Force IV, as seen on Idol 9 Round 6. I couldn't optimize this as well as I wanted tho, but I still think it's nice enough to submit lol

Anyway, the best way this would fit is in a space or water level, preferably on a level with a more mysterious vibe. Not many uses outside of that tho.

EDIT: Apparently, on the original submission, the volume on the fourth snare note at the 1:09 part of the SPC was playing too low, so it cutted off very abruptly when it wasn't supposed to do that. I fixed it now. :)
